طَلُوبٌ , of which the pl. is طُلُبٌ, (K, TA,) and, as is said in the Msb, [but not in my copy of it,] طُلْبٌ; (TA;) and ↓ طَلَّابٌ , of which the pl. is طَلَّابُونَ; and ↓ طَلِيبٌ , of which the pl. is طُلَبَآءُ; Seeking, desiring, or demanding; or seeking, desiring, or endeavouring, to find and to get or take; (K, TA;) much, or often; all are intensive in signification. (TA.) ―
-b2- And بِئْرٌ طَلُوبٌ (O, TA) [and] ↓ طَلِيبٌ (thus in a copy of the A) A well of which the water is remote: (A, O, TA:) pl. of the former أَبْآرٌ طُلُبٌ. (O, TA.) See also طُلْبَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
